children: Sweden investment firm's Q2 net sales fell sharply yr/yr, operating loss narrowed
Company settled call options in Observit and resolved on a directed set-off share issue
After Q2, company completed fully subscribed rights issue and oversubscribed Cloud Explorers offering
SpectrumOne plans to pursue a separate listing for Cloud Explorers following a directed share issue
Company will continue funding Health Impact Alliance as it approaches a commercial launch in late autumn
SpectrumOne intends to reallocate capital during autumn to meet commitments and balance its portfolio
